arStrings.szText: "Ivo? Your brother Bovram is looking for you."
Ah, yes. My dear brother Bovram—of course! He’s here in Skovos? Oh, praise be!
I thank you, kind stranger, for the good tidings and for your “valiant” effort to save my life. In truth, nothing in this wilderness is a danger to me.
Finding me in the forest like this, and Bovram so near...such fortuitous circumstances as these call for a celebration!
Go find Bovram, and come to my little slice of solitude in the eastern forest. Now, I must be going—so much to prepare!
